name: operacoes-agricolas-balanca
description: Sistema local para auditoria de divergencias entre OS, talhoes liberados e entradas de cana na balanca.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @balanca/shared && npm-run-all -p dev:api dev:web dev:desktop
scripts.dev:browser: npm run build -w @balanca/shared && npm-run-all -p dev:api dev:web
scripts.dev:desktop: wait-on tcp:8833 tcp:8873 && npm run dev -w @balanca/desktop
scripts.build:browser: npm run build -w @balanca/shared && npm run build -w @balanca/api && npm run build -w @balanca/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @balanca/shared && npm run build -w @balanca/api && npm run build -w @balanca/web && npm run build -w @balanca/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @balanca/shared && npm run typecheck -w @balanca/api && npm run typecheck -w @balanca/web && npm run typecheck -w @balanca/desktop
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
